- Organic classification, no airdrop dump, and low bundle share (1.3%) and top-3 concentration (7.4%) suggest no obvious insider-cluster setup.
- Broad early participation: 832 buyers on the curve and 305 buyers in the first two minutes after graduation.
- The last 15 minutes still show 147 buyers against 160 sellers, with a sell-to-buy ratio near 1.1 in the launch window, so demand is not vanishing outright.

Against that, the momentum is clearly broken. The coin is down 86% over 30 minutes and 87% off its high, with net outflow of 8.3 SOL in the last 15 minutes and sellers outnumbering buyers. Pool depth is only 30.5 SOL, so a round trip at this size will cost meaningfully, and the brief gives no evidence that demand is stabilizing rather than still bleeding. A launch bot was also present, which fits the pattern of early speculative flow that leaves.

My conclusion: there is no strong case that real demand will still be here in 30-60 minutes. Skip this coin.
